account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Person Account Id. Bound from the verify result.

apartment_id.title: Apartment Id
apartment_id.description: Occupied apartment Id selected by the script. The model cannot change it.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short description of the maintenance problem, written from the resident's words.

is_active_tenant.title: Is Active Tenant
is_active_tenant.description: Must be true. Bound from the verify result.

is_valid_user.title: Is Valid User
is_valid_user.description: Must be true. Bound from the verify result.

issue_type.title: Issue Type
issue_type.description: FaucetLeak, NoPower, or Other. Any other value is stored as Other.

messaging_session_id.title: Messaging Session Id
messaging_session_id.description: Current messaging session Id. Used only to copy the contact.
